summary: Verified the /track submit bug fix end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (track exact/lowercase/leading-trailing-%20/inner-%20/invalid-404, PII masking, no _id, booking create + validation errors, admin login). Frontend: all 6 track scenarios pass from base /track (uppercase, lowercase, invalid, deep-link auto-load, empty submit toast, whitespace-padded input) with API call confirmed on each submit, plus booking happy-path regression (created KHR-2026-000009, /book/success shows success-job-number, Track Your Request navigates and renders result).

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/track/<num> is fired TWICE per submit (onSubmit calls doSearch directly AND nav() to /track/:jobNumber re-triggers the useEffect on [jobNumber]). Functionally correct but a duplicate network call / double setState; consider guarding the effect (skip when the number just searched equals jobNumber).

issues: Error text renders backend detail 'Request not found' instead of the intended friendly copy 'Request not found. Please check the number.' because errMessage prefers server detail over the fallback
preferred_date uses native browser <input type=date> picker instead of the shadcn calendar component (styling inconsistency with rest of the premium UI)

action_items: Optional: dedupe the double /api/track call on submit (nav + useEffect both trigger doSearch)
Optional: show the friendly fallback copy for 404 track errors instead of raw backend detail
critical_code_review_comments: TrackPage useEffect([jobNumber]) + direct doSearch in onSubmit causes duplicate requests; nav() with replace already re-runs the effect.
Track endpoint correctly excludes _id and masks name/phone; no PII (address/email/phone raw) leaked - verified by assertions.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test bookings via API/UI (TEST QA User / TEST Rajesh Verma) - job numbers up to KHR-2026-000009 now exist
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). Track bug is FIXED. Admin dashboard CRUD (status updates, filters, stats) has not been exercised in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: onSubmit only navigated and relied on useEffect([jobNumber]) to search; when the URL already matched or the effect race occurred, doSearch never ran. Current fix (direct doSearch call + server-side re.sub whitespace/upper normalization) verified working across uppercase, lowercase and whitespace-padded inputs.
